Developers should update the logic in the table2model function within django/core/management/commands/inspectdb.py to extract the referenced column and table from the relations dictionary. Then, by checking if the primary key of the referenced table does not match the referenced column, the code should set the extra parameter 'to_field' accordingly. The implementation should focus solely on the introspection logic without regard to test modifications.
